finale.title: Finale: a real mamak

clips.title: “BOSS! Teh Tarik satu” — Only In Malaysia @Mamak (TV3 Malaysia)
clips.listenFor: Customers calling out orders to mamak staff — listen for item + number (teh tarik satu) and how staff are addressed (boss).

easy.q: Did you hear anyone order a drink using “[drink] satu”?

medium.q: How do customers address the staff? Did you catch “boss”, “bang” or something else?

hard.q: Write down one full order you understood, word for word, then replay to check it.

clips.title: Night vlog — dinner time di kedai mamak (Fitri's Diary)
clips.listenFor: Any moment of ordering at the table: drinks first, then food.

easy.q: Did you catch the name of at least one drink or dish?

medium.q: Did you catch one complete order (item + number or tweak)?

hard.q: Could you follow the order without replaying? Note any word you missed.

clips.title: Restoran Melayu macam kedai mamak — Sri Has review (FuyohhTV)
clips.listenFor: Food-review talk about dishes and lauk — listen for dish names and words like sedap, pedas, kuah.

easy.q: Did you recognise any dish name?

medium.q: Did you catch one describing word (sedap, pedas, manis…)?

hard.q: Summarise in one English sentence what the speaker thinks of the food.
